chapters.title: Introduction and Reshmee's journey into Microsoft technologies
Responsible Copilot adoption, permissions and Purview
Customer concerns about AI and keeping up with change
Microsoft Build announcements and Copilot readiness
Copilot extensibility: from SharePoint agents to Foundry
Identity, governance, metadata and information architecture

takeaways: Rolling out Copilot safely starts with permission hygiene and Purview guardrails, because Copilot surfaces any data a user already has access to.
Copilot extensibility spans SharePoint agents, Agent Builder, Copilot Studio, the Agents Toolkit and Microsoft Foundry, and the right choice depends on the use case.
Multi-agent solutions use an orchestrator with smaller specialized agents that are easier to test and maintain, while MCP tools, Entra-based agent identity and good metadata keep them controllable.
hook: Many organizations want AI agents but struggle to move from demo to a trustworthy enterprise solution. This episode is for Microsoft 365 architects, makers and governance leads, and covers with MVP Reshmee Auckloo how to roll out Copilot responsibly and design multi-agent solutions with Copilot Studio, Foundry, MCP and SharePoint.
